venue.name: Victoria Butterfly Gardens
venue.description: Victoria Butterfly Gardens is an indoor tropical garden at 1461 Benvenuto Avenue in Brentwood Bay, roughly 20 km north of downtown Victoria and a few minutes from Butchart Gardens. The site describes a 12,000 square foot rainforest environment with thousands of butterflies from up to 70 species, free flying tropical birds, poison dart frogs, tortoises, an iguana, a flamingo, koi and an insectarium. It is kept between 26 and 30 degrees at about 70 percent humidity and is open every day except Christmas Day. Group bookings are taken for 10 or more paying guests with at least 48 hours notice.
venue.address: 1461 Benvenuto Avenue, Brentwood Bay, BC V8M 1J5

facility_notes.lunch_space: Outside food and drink are not permitted inside the Gardens. While there is no cafe on-site, there are nearby dining options in Brentwood Bay. Light snacks and ice cream bars are available in the gift shop.
facility_notes.rain_backup: The indoor environment is warm and humid to mimic a tropical rainforest.
facility_notes.stroller_accessible: Yes, strollers are permitted, and the pathways are stroller friendly.
facility_notes.wheelchair_accessible: Yes, the Gardens are fully wheelchair accessible, including designated parking and accessible entrances. A complimentary wheelchair or stroller is available by request, first come first served.
facility_notes.bus_parking: Yes, free parking is available on-site for all visitors.

restrictions: Outside food and drink are not permitted inside the Gardens.
Guides and chaperones are responsible for supervising youth at all times.
Annual passes, coupons, or other discounts cannot be combined with group rates.
For the safety of our free-roaming animals, only leashed service and support dogs that are trained to provide medical services to their handler are allowed inside the building.
venue.hours_notes: Winter, January 1 to June 13: daily 10:00 to 17:00, last admission 16:00. Summer, June 14 to September 4: Monday to Wednesday 9:00 to 17:00, last admission 16:00, Thursday to Sunday 9:00 to 19:00, last admission 18:00. Fall, September 5 to December 13: daily 10:00 to 17:00, last admission 16:00.
venue.seasonal_notes: Open every day except Christmas Day. Holiday hours run December 14 to 31, with December 24 and December 31 closing at 16:00.

programs.name: Group visit
programs.description: The group rate applies to bookings of 10 or more paying guests, made at least 48 hours ahead, with one combined payment for all admissions. They take cash, VISA, MasterCard, AMEX and debit. The group rate itself is not published on the site. Annual passes, coupons and other discounts cannot be combined with it. The site says most visitors spend 45 minutes to 1.5 hours in the Gardens, which is a guide rather than a booked slot.
programs.what_children_do: Walk a looping path through a warm, humid indoor jungle, looking for free flying butterflies and birds, poison dart frogs, tortoises, an iguana, a flamingo and koi in the pond. The Gardens publish two scavenger hunt lists children can work through as they go.
programs.our_note: It is 26 to 30 degrees and humid inside, so coats and outdoor layers come off at the door and someone has to carry them. Outside food is not allowed in and there is no cafe, so plan lunch off site, before or after.
programs.practical_summary: Fully indoors and step-free, with free parking and strollers allowed, so weather is not a worry. They do not publish the group price, whether a bus can park, or anything about washrooms, so ask when you book.
programs.payment_timing: One combined payment is made for all admissions. Accepted payment: cash, VISA, MasterCard, AMEX, Debit
programs.evidence: Group bookings are for 10 or more paying guests and need to be booked 48 hours in advance.

programs.name: Guided tour
programs.description: The group page says guided tours are available by request from October through April. A separate line at the top of the same page says they cannot accommodate guided tours after June 25th. No price, length, group size or age range is published for a guided tour.
programs.our_note: Their two lines about tours do not agree, so treat a guided tour as something to confirm rather than assume. Ask well before you settle on a date.
programs.practical_summary: Only offered in the cooler half of the year, and nothing is published about how long a tour runs or what it costs on top of admission.
programs.evidence: Guided tours only available by requests October through April.

gaps: The group rate itself is not published. The page only says a group rate applies once you meet the conditions, so the price per child has to be asked for.
youngest age welcomed is not stated. Infants aged 0 to 4 get in free, but nothing says whether daycare and preschool groups are taken on the group rate, so that needs asking.
maximum group size is not stated; only the minimum of 10 paying guests.
washrooms are not mentioned anywhere on the site, including the accessibility answers.
bus parking is not stated. The only parking line is that free parking is available on-site for all visitors.
how many adults have to come with a group is not stated. The site only says guides and chaperones are responsible for supervising youth at all times.
price and length of a guided tour are not published.
There is no cafe and outside food and drink are not allowed inside, so there is no indoor lunch space. Nothing is said about a spot outside where a group could eat.
The group booking form is a JavaScript widget and did not appear in a plain fetch, so what it asks for is not recorded. The group rate may be quoted through it.
